scientific_integrity: Counts, 462 five-support exclusions, complete witness trees, and dimension recurrences are reproduced by a standalone verifier. General product and leaf-support gluing arguments are independently stated as mathematics; finite computation is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite path minimality classification is restricted to 1 through 11 vertices; no exact formula for longer paths or arbitrary trees is claimed. Connected-tree amplification is proved for the specified glued family only. Historical-priority risk remains; no independent review performed.
title: The first adaptive shattering gap for minimal dominating sets of paths, amplified inside connected trees
